verdict.rationale: Mistral positions Document AI for on-premises deployment, and the OCR 4 announcement says the model can run in a single container so document data stays in your environment. That makes self-hosting a vendor-stated option, but it appears to be an enterprise sales offering rather than a documented, openly available self-host path. Missing for 10: public self-hosting/deployment documentation, clarity on licensing or how a user obtains the container, independent or hands-on corroboration of a self-hosted deployment.
